name: Omarchy Tool
author: Omarchy Tool contributors
description: Toolbox for Omarchy: a bar panel with switchable system tweaks. Share disks and pass USB devices to Omarchy's Windows VM, enable WebHID for browser device configurators, and turn installed plugins on and off.

barWidget.description: Switchable system tweaks: disks and USB devices in the Windows VM, WebHID in the browser.
